detail.title: Architectural Gaps in Computational Selfhood Models
detail.summary: Existing research on automated systems focuses heavily on functional performance, hypothesis validation [source-0c3114b8bfe140df], and ethical auditing [source-f26a645e047847a2]. While these frameworks address the governance and behavioral reliability of systems, they do not provide architectural definitions for persistent identity or internal mechanisms that distinguish long-term self-continuity from episodic memory retrieval.
